verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a public REST API (plus an MCP server) that exposes the same retrieval and synthesis surface as the web app, supports automated searches, and has at least one documented request parameter (excludePreprints). The evidence covers the API's existence and scope but not its reference depth. Missing for 10: detailed endpoint reference, authentication and rate-limit documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: API and agent ready: a REST API and an MCP server expose the same retrieval and synthesis surface that powers the web app
run automated searches with our API to quickly and easily find the most relevant and reliable research
pass `exclude_preprints=true` (MCP) or `excludePreprints=true` (REST API) to filter to peer-reviewed papers only.
Connect the Consensus API within your project to seamlessly integrate up-to-date peer-reviewed citations into your own custom workflow.
